name: open-file-lines
description: Click a path:400-410 reference in any text to open the file and select that range

commands.title: Open File Lines: Open File at Cursor
Open File Lines: Open File at Cursor to the Side

openFileLines.searchPaths.markdownDescription: Extra folders to look in when a link is not found next to the current file or in a workspace root. Absolute paths are used as is; relative ones are resolved against the current file's folder and against every workspace root. Supports `~`, `${workspaceFolder}` and `${userHome}`.

openFileLines.extensions.description: Extensions tried, in order, when the link has no extension of its own. Set to an empty array to disable guessing.

openFileLines.delimiters.description: Characters that end a path when it is picked up from the text around the cursor. Backtick and quotes are included, which is why `path:1-2` inside apostrophes works.

openFileLines.selectLines.description: Select the referenced line range. When off, the cursor is only moved to the first line.

openFileLines.preview.description: Open the file in preview mode (the tab is reused by the next preview and its title stays italic).
